title: [20/4/2023] The recycling process of aluminium cans
prompt: The diagram below shows the recycling process of aluminium cans. Summarise the information by selecting and reporting the main features, and make comparisons where relevant.

frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The diagram illustrates the complete cycle of aluminium can recycling process in the UK, from collection to reuse.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, this circular process consists of seven main stages with various mechanical and thermal procedures, beginning with the collection of used aluminium cans and ending with reusing.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: At the start, people dispose of used cans in designated aluminium recycling bins, which are then collected by recycling trucks. Following this, the cans undergo several preparatory steps including cleaning, sorting, shredding, and compressing. Thereafter, the processed material is then subjected to heating and melting, which transforms the solid aluminium into a liquid state.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: In the subsequent stage of the process, the melted aluminium is rolled into sheets measuring between 2.5mm and 6mm in thickness. These sheets then enter the recycling phase where they are formed into new cans. Finally, the cycle completes at the reusing stage, where 74% of aluminium cans are recycled to be distributed for consumer use.
